definitions.explanation: The skin of the head, where the hair grows.

examples.japanese: {頭皮|とうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{頭皮|とうひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かゆい→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧。
examples.english: My scalp itches because it is dry.

examples.japanese: {頭皮|とうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{清潔|せいけつ}→清潔：01583_seiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Keeping your scalp clean is also important for healthy hair.

notes:
USAGE:
- The word of shampoo advertising, hair salons and medicine. In casual talk people just say ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧ (⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かゆい→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧, my head itches).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頭皮|とうひ}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧: scalp care
- {頭皮|とうひ}⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧: scalp massage
- {頭皮|とうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧: dry scalp

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{逃避|とうひ}→逃避：14419_touhi⟧ (escape, flight from reality) has the same reading.
